versions.changelog:
- Expanded documentation and usage guidance for the "huawei-cloud-cc-central-network-query" skill.
- Clearly outlines scope: only supports read/query operations for central network instances, attachments (ER route table, GDGW), and connections.
- Lists specific triggers and provides explicit instructions on unsupported operations (e.g., policy, quota, capability, and tag management).
- Adds prerequisites and command templates for listing and showing central network resources.
- Improves clarity on attachment type handling and single connection queries.
- Ensures users are informed when their request is out of skill scope and provides alternative action suggestions.
